## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (it becomes the commit on `main`).
- [ ] Lint, type check, tests and build pass locally with no new warnings.
- [ ] I read the full diff: no duplicated or dead code, no debug output, no unrelated changes.
- [ ] User-facing changes were checked on desktop and mobile and with the keyboard.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data are committed, and no new vulnerabilities are introduced.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if behavior or workflow changed.
